purpose: 依据文档装备插画提取、修复透明独立素材；旧铁剑为同画法的朴素旧剑变体。

prompts.common: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Asset type: individual equipment illustration for the existing Chinese ink-wash RPG UI. Input image is the original UI reference; preserve the specified item's actual design, proportions, muted colors and delicate ink/watercolor drawing, not the surrounding interface. Produce ONE isolated high-resolution item on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas. Entire item visible, centered within the central 80% of canvas, equal comfortable margin, no cropping. Remove ALL original paper rectangle, landscape, flowers, text, labels, frame, UI, watermark. No photorealism, no 3D render, no flat line icon, no glow, no new ornamentation. Fine ink outlines and subtle desaturated painted shading match the reference.

specs.prompt: Extract and restore ONLY the blue-steel straight 青锋剑 in the first equipment row beneath the character card. Keep the long pointed steel blade, black wrapped handle, dark guard and blue tassel, diagonal lower left tip to upper right handle.
Extract and restore ONLY the 柳叶短刀 in the second equipment row. Keep the short slightly curved blade, black and aged brass hilt, dark hanging tassel. Diagonal lower left tip to upper right handle.

Extract and restore ONLY the 青衫 cloth robe in the small left-column 衣甲 slot. Whole standalone empty blue-gray cloth robe with sleeves, ivory inner collar, tied waist and full lower hem. Preserve that plain flowing garment, no mannequin, no person, no armor. Centered front three-quarter view.

Extract and restore ONLY the pair of 云履 boots in the small left-column 足部 slot. Whole pair of black-brown Chinese martial boots in the same three-quarter view, with the tall folded shafts and subtle aged trim. Preserve the reference shapes, no modern shoes, no armor additions.

Create the plain worn 旧铁剑 variant of the illustrated 青锋剑 using exactly the SAME ink/watercolor technique and diagonal pose: a simple dull grey iron straight sword, wrapped dark cloth grip, plain straight iron crossguard, a few small worn chips in the blade. Remove ornate brass/blue-tassel embellishments so it reads as the humble old starter weapon. One complete painted sword, not a line icon.
